title: jmap-client: port error.rs and auth.rs
description: Port ClientError and all auth providers from crate-jmapchat-client into crate-jmap-client/src/error.rs and src/auth.rs. These are prerequisites for every other module in this crate. NOTE: this is NOT a verbatim copy — one variant must be removed and a doc comment updated.
design: Copy src/auth.rs verbatim — AuthProvider trait, BearerAuth, BasicAuth, NoneAuth, CustomCaTransport, DefaultTransport, TransportConfig have no Chat-specific types. Update crate name in doc comments. For src/error.rs: copy ClientError but REMOVE the ClientError::RateLimited variant — it is Chat-specific (rate limiting is handled by the Chat server, not the base JMAP client). Confirm no other Chat-specific variants exist before copying.
